scope: Proposition 7.7 (Recovery on the preceding Koszul object) of the manuscript “Finite Smith–Toda Complexes at Varying Primes” (preprints/Finite-Smith-Toda-Complexes-at-Varying-Primes-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 308 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 13dce3978089a78f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 39-40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
